rule: New host operations take max(number) + 1 at merge time. Recheck after merging current main; never reuse a gap or renumber an existing operation. Edit only this registry, then run node scripts/native-bridge/gen-host-ops.mjs.

operations.name: REGION_PICK
documentation: mode (0 contains, 1 closest), frame origin x z, point, tie, segments,
candidate count and region indices -> the indices of the selected regions
among the candidates (region_query.rs).

operations.name: SKETCH_REGION
documentation: lines, arcs, circle count and circles (x y r) -> the arrangement regions of
the closed chains and circles (sketch_regions.rs).

operations.name: SKETCH_EXTRUDE
documentation: key, frame, depth, reverse, lines, arcs, circles, region index -> the prism
of one arrangement region.

operations.name: MESH
documentation: deviation (f64), body count and WC0 words per body -> JSON `wonky-mesh/1`:
the tessellation the STL is written from, before f32 quantisation, with the
WC0 face id of every triangle and the sampled polyline of every WC0 edge
(mesh.rs). An unattributable producer reports `faces: []`.

operations.name: CARRIERS
documentation: World-space analytic surface and curve carriers of every WC0 face and edge
(millimetres, one rounding after the exact frame composition; see carriers.rs).

operations.name: SKETCH_PICK
documentation: mode (0 contains, 1 closest), frame origin x z, point, tie, lines, arcs,
circles, candidate count and region indices -> the indices of the selected
arrangement regions among the candidates (sketch_pick.rs).

operations.name: CURVE_EXTRUDE
documentation: key[4] rev, frame origin x z, depth, reverse, n, n binary64 sketch rule 3
parameters (`wonky_contract::sketch3`: region 0 and one closed chain with a
spline) -> WC0 v3 words of the curve-profile prism (`curve_profile`).
Strand S9; FeatureScript reaches it through `skBezier` (strand S10) and
`opExtrude` of the sketch.

operations.name: CURVE_REGION
documentation: n, n binary64 sketch rule 3 parameters (region 0) -> `{"loops":[{}],
"openWires":0}` when the entities form one simple closed chain with a spline
(`curve_profile::profile`, the admission `OP_CURVE_EXTRUDE` runs), or that
admission's refusal. Strand S10: `skSolve` of a sketch that holds a `skBezier`.

operations.name: CERTIFIED_BOUNDS
documentation: Audited outward-rounded world enclosure for interference enumeration.

operations.name: PAIR_PROOF
documentation: Sufficient no-volume/contact or positive-clearance proof; null is inconclusive.

operations.name: PAIR_PREPARE
documentation: Assembly setup: audit and memoize an immutable source predicate once.
